title: Bank transfer deposits: expected processing times
content: Bank transfer deposits may take between 1 and 24 hours depending on the sending bank and compliance checks. If funds do not appear after 24 hours, ask the customer for the transaction reference and proof of transfer.

title: Account deletion and closure requests
content: Account closure and deletion requests must be handled by a trained human agent. Remaining balances must be withdrawn or otherwise resolved before closure. Do not promise immediate deletion.

title: Identity verification document upload issues
content: Supported document formats are JPG, JPEG, PNG, and PDF. Maximum file size is 10 MB. If upload fails, advise the customer to retry with one of the supported formats under the file-size limit. Escalate if repeated failures persist after valid retry attempts.

title: Password reset troubleshooting
content: Ask the customer to check the spam and promotions folders, confirm the registered email address is correct, and retry after a few minutes. Reset emails may take up to 10 minutes to arrive. Escalate if the issue persists.

title: Two-factor authentication (2FA) code not received
content: If a 2FA SMS code is not arriving, ask the customer to confirm the phone number on file, check signal coverage, and retry after 2 minutes. If repeated attempts fail, advise switching to the authenticator app option if available. Escalate if no codes arrive after multiple attempts.

title: Refund policy and request handling
content: Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis by the finance team and require human review. Do not promise refunds in customer communication. Collect transaction details and route the request to the finance team.

title: Withdrawal processing times
content: Withdrawals to bank accounts typically take 1-3 business days to complete. Withdrawals may remain in 'pending' status during compliance review. If the status has not changed after 3 business days, escalate to the payments team with the withdrawal reference.

title: Suspected fraud or unauthorized account access
content: Any report of unauthorized access, suspected fraud, or unrecognized transactions must be treated as a security incident. Do not draft an AI reply. Escalate immediately to the security team for account review and possible freeze.
